Projects#

With over 4 years of professional development experience, I’ve had the
opportunity to contribute to a variety of projects across different companies.
Below is a list of some apps I have worked on during my past experience:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


C-Wallet#

📌 Fintech | Blockchain | Mobile Money

Cwallet is a blockchain-powered mobile money wallet that evolves around three
core principles: Payroll, Payment, and Remittance.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Gym-Switch#

📌 Fitness | Membership | Multi-Gym Access

Gym Switch offers users the ability to access all gyms in Tunisia, providing
flexibility and convenience for fitness enthusiasts.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Bitaqa#

📌 Digital Business Card | Contact Sharing

A simple tap for impressive connections. Instantly share your social networks
and contact details in an elegant and convenient way.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


DGCaisse#

📌 POS System | Retail & Restaurants

DGCaisse provides a variety of POS (Point of Sale) options tailored for
restaurants, retail businesses, and multi-purpose sales environments.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Digishop#

📌 E-Commerce | LINE Platform Integration

A new approach in the digital marketplace using the LINE platform, helping
businesses achieve their goals effectively.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Dieture#

📌 Health | Nutrition | Meal Plans

A platform offering personalized diet plans for weight loss and well-being,
featuring effective keto plans and healthy meal options in Qatar.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ZenFeat#

📌 Culinary Platform | Chefs & Cooks

A space for chefs & cooks to showcase their culinary skills, adventures, and
experiences in one place.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


MoneyGo#

📌 Finance | Secure Transactions

MoneyGo ensures maximum security and anonymity for personal and financial data,
integrating SSL/TLS encryption for cutting-edge data protection.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


S.T.A.L.K.E.R.S Mobile Game#

📌 Multiplayer Game | Backend & CI/CD

A third-person shooter multiplayer mobile game, where up to 40 players compete
on an uncharted island.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


El-Mall#

📌 E-Commerce | Secure Shopping

A comprehensive online shopping platform offering a wide range of products with
fast, secure, and reliable delivery.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Float Browser Extension#

📌 Productivity | Chrome Extension

Rated the #1 Resource Management Software on G2, Float is a Chrome extension
that enhances accessibility and usability.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Azure Cloud / CI/CD#

📌 DevOps | Cloud Computing

Internal client work related to CI/CD pipelines, Azure services, and DevOps
automation.
